A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed and developed a novel geometric algorithm that can be applied to a wide range of stochastic systems, including systems with multiple scales, high-dimensionality and stochastic noise.
we have developed a new approach for learning high-dimensional stochastic systems near manifolds, and we have proved theoretical guarantees about the accuracy of this learning algorithm.
